_format.name: display name
_format.scene: battle backdrop, a key of THEMES in js/scene.js
_format.stage: order on the stage map; each stage unlocks after the one before is beaten
_format.hp: hit points; the warrior's strikes drain them as the run covers the goal distance
_format.attack: damage per 30-second check when the runner is well off the pace target
_format.goal.distanceKm: distance to run in one go to win the fight
_format.goal.paceByLevel: pace target in seconds per km for levels 1 (slow runners) to 5 (fast runners)
